name: Taihangosuchus
sum: Taihangosuchus is a gracilisuchid pseudosuchian from the Middle Triassic Ermaying Formation of Shanxi Province, China.
wsnote: No body length is given; the holotype skull is about 18 cm long and its humerus 9 cm (English Wikipedia).
holotype: SNHM V2014 (Shanxi Natural History Museum): a skull and partial skeleton with nine cervical vertebrae, both humeri and part of the right pectoral girdle.
material: The holotype and a paratype, SNHM V2015.
biology: The sources consulted give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Wu et al. 2025

sources.text: Wu, X.-C., Kang, Z., Shi, J., You, H.-L. and Dong, L. 2025. Taihangosuchus wuxiangensis, a new gracilisuchid (Archosauria: Pseudosuchia) from the Middle Triassic of Shanxi Province, China. Historical Biology 1-36.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Anisian per English Wikipedia; whole ICS stage used.
